arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE years(y) AS (SELECT 2000 UNION ALL SELECT y+1 FROM years WHERE y<2019),
ints AS (SELECT a.y sy,b.y ey,b.y-a.y+1 dur FROM years a JOIN years b ON b.y>=a.y),
cq AS (
 SELECT station,CAST(substr(dt,1,4) AS INT) y,
 CASE WHEN CAST(substr(dt,6,2) AS INT)<=3 THEN 1 WHEN CAST(substr(dt,6,2) AS INT)<=6 THEN 2 WHEN CAST(substr(dt,6,2) AS INT)<=9 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END q,
 COUNT(*) n
 FROM c GROUP BY station,y,q
),
base_sy AS (SELECT station,y FROM cq GROUP BY station,y HAVING COUNT(*)=4),
base_mem AS (
 SELECT i.sy,i.ey,i.dur,s.station FROM ints i JOIN base_sy s ON s.y BETWEEN i.sy AND i.ey
 GROUP BY i.sy,i.ey,i.dur,s.station HAVING COUNT(*)=i.dur
),
base_dw AS (
 SELECT sy,ey,dur,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY sy,ey) cov,
 group_concat(station,';') OVER(PARTITION BY sy,ey ORDER BY station ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) cohort,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY sy,ey ORDER BY station) rn
 FROM base_mem
),
base_design AS (SELECT sy,ey,dur,cov,cohort FROM base_dw WHERE rn=1 AND cov>=2),
base_front AS (
 SELECT d.* FROM base_design d WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM base_design x WHERE x.dur>=d.dur AND x.cov>=d.cov AND (x.dur>d.dur OR x.cov>d.cov))
),
w AS (
 SELECT *,CAST(substr(dt,1,4) AS INT) wy,
 CASE WHEN CAST(substr(dt,6,2) AS INT)<=3 THEN 1 WHEN CAST(substr(dt,6,2) AS INT)<=6 THEN 2 WHEN CAST(substr(dt,6,2) AS INT)<=9 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END wq
 FROM c
),
post_sy AS (
 SELECT w.act wact,s.station,s.y
 FROM w CROSS JOIN base_sy s
 WHERE NOT (s.station=w.station AND s.y=w.wy AND
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cq WHERE cq.station=w.station AND cq.y=w.wy AND cq.q=w.wq AND cq.n=1))
),
pm AS (
 SELECT ps.wact,i.sy,i.ey,i.dur,ps.station
 FROM post_sy ps JOIN ints i ON ps.y BETWEEN i.sy AND i.ey
 GROUP BY ps.wact,i.sy,i.ey,i.dur,ps.station HAVING COUNT(*)=i.dur
),
pdw AS (
 SELECT wact,sy,ey,dur,station,
 COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY wact,sy,ey) cov,
 group_concat(station,';') OVER(PARTITION BY wact,sy,ey ORDER BY station ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) cohort,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY wact,sy,ey ORDER BY station) rn
 FROM pm
),
pd AS (SELECT wact,sy,ey,dur,cov,cohort FROM pdw WHERE rn=1 AND cov>=2),
pf AS (
 SELECT d.* FROM pd d WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pd x WHERE x.wact=d.wact AND x.dur>=d.dur AND x.cov>=d.cov AND (x.dur>d.dur OR x.cov>d.cov))
),
changing AS (
 SELECT w.act wact FROM w
 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pf WHERE pf.wact=w.act)<>(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_front)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf WHERE pf.wact=w.act AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM base_front b WHERE b.sy=pf.sy AND b.ey=pf.ey AND b.cohort=pf.cohort))
),
cand AS (
 SELECT pf.wact,pf.sy,pf.ey,pf.cov,pf.cohort,e.*,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY pf.wact,pf.sy,pf.ey ORDER BY e.oxy,e.dt,
   CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.tm,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,e.tm,e.station,e.act) pick
 FROM pf JOIN changing ch ON ch.wact=pf.wact
 JOIN pm ON pm.wact=pf.wact AND pm.sy=pf.sy AND pm.ey=pf.ey
 JOIN w ww ON ww.act=pf.wact
 JOIN c e ON e.station=pm.station AND CAST(substr(e.dt,1,4) AS INT) BETWEEN pf.sy AND pf.ey
 AND (CASE WHEN CAST(substr(e.dt,6,2) AS INT)<=3 THEN 1 WHEN CAST(substr(e.dt,6,2) AS INT)<=6 THEN 2 WHEN CAST(substr(e.dt,6,2) AS INT)<=9 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END)=ww.wq
 AND e.act<>pf.wact
),
cc AS (SELECT wact,sy,ey,COUNT(DISTINCT org||char(31)||act) cnt FROM cand GROUP BY wact,sy,ey)
SELECT ww.org withdrawn_org,ww.act withdrawn_act,ww.station withdrawn_station,ww.dt withdrawn_date,
ca.sy,ca.ey,ca.cov,ca.cohort,'Q'||ww.wq quarter,cc.cnt,
ca.org selected_org,ca.station selected_station,ca.act selected_act,ca.dt selected_date,
printf('%.2f',ca.oxy) oxygen,printf('%.2f',ca.temp) temperature,printf('%.2f',ca.cond) conductance,printf('%.2f',ca.ph) ph
FROM cand ca JOIN cc ON cc.wact=ca.wact AND cc.sy=ca.sy AND cc.ey=ca.ey
JOIN w ww ON ww.act=ca.wact
WHERE ca.pick=1
ORDER BY ww.act,ca.sy,ca.ey

arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE years(y) AS (VALUES(2000) UNION ALL SELECT y+1 FROM years WHERE y<2019),
wins(s,e) AS (SELECT a.y,b.y FROM years a JOIN years b ON b.y>=a.y),
qcnt AS (SELECT site,yr,qtr,COUNT(*) n FROM p GROUP BY site,yr,qtr),
bsy AS (SELECT site,yr FROM qcnt GROUP BY site,yr HAVING COUNT(*)=4),
tsy AS (
 SELECT t.act trial,b.site,b.yr
 FROM p t CROSS JOIN bsy b
 WHERE NOT (b.site=t.site AND b.yr=t.yr AND
    (SELECT n FROM qcnt q WHERE q.site=t.site AND q.yr=t.yr AND q.qtr=t.qtr)=1)
),
cohort_rows AS (
 SELECT tsy.trial,w.s,w.e,tsy.site
 FROM tsy JOIN wins w ON tsy.yr BETWEEN w.s AND w.e
 GROUP BY tsy.trial,w.s,w.e,tsy.site
 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tsy.yr)=w.e-w.s+1
),
feas AS (
 SELECT trial,s,e,COUNT(*) cov
 FROM cohort_rows GROUP BY trial,s,e HAVING COUNT(*)>=2
),
front AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM feas f WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM feas x WHERE x.trial=f.trial
   AND (x.e-x.s+1)>=(f.e-f.s+1) AND x.cov>=f.cov
   AND ((x.e-x.s+1)>(f.e-f.s+1) OR x.cov>f.cov))
),
orig AS (
 SELECT 2013 s,2019 e,2 cov,'USGS-08057410;USGS-08067000' cohort UNION ALL
 SELECT 2014,2014,4,'USGS-08057410;USGS-08065350;USGS-08067000;USGS-08067252' UNION ALL
 SELECT 2014,2015,3,'USGS-08057410;USGS-08067000;USGS-08067252'
),
fd AS (
 SELECT f.trial,f.s,f.e,f.cov,
  (SELECT group_concat(site,';') FROM
    (SELECT site FROM cohort_rows c WHERE c.trial=f.trial AND c.s=f.s AND c.e=f.e ORDER BY site)
  ) cohort
 FROM front f
),
changed AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT t.act trial FROM p t WHERE
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fd WHERE fd.trial=t.act AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 1 FROM orig o WHERE o.s=fd.s AND o.e=fd.e AND o.cov=fd.cov AND o.cohort=fd.cohort))
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orig o WHERE NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 1 FROM fd WHERE fd.trial=t.act AND fd.s=o.s AND fd.e=o.e AND fd.cov=o.cov AND fd.cohort=o.cohort))
)
SELECT p.org,p.act,p.site,p.dt,p.qtr,fd.s,fd.e,fd.cov,fd.cohort
FROM changed c JOIN p ON p.act=c.trial LEFT JOIN fd ON fd.trial=c.trial
ORDER BY p.act,fd.s,fd.e
